base: origin/main 23376d18 (round 6 live; nissan candidate at round 6)
tool: census on the groups origin/main ships, with this branch's build_window read with and without the round-7 rules (curate.Curation._r7); lot rows = car x group rows of the vehicle-year in the main replay
model_year_span: 07/(y-1)-06/y; decision 2 widens the changeover test by one month either way

classes.d1_page_cut: a page that lists the number cuts the span while the union of the pages covered it (or an undated page sat beside a dated cutting one); no built gate on main
classes.d2_changeover: a same-option number changes over with this one inside the span +-1 month; no built gate
classes.d3_split: undated on T's page beside a same-option number whose split another page dates; no built gate
classes.d4_cross_position: group: the number's known position (FR/RR/FL/RL/L/R...) differs between models
classes.d5_star_blind: nissan: read without the mark, a drive / engine limit appears or changes
classes.x_two_numbers_undated_no_date: information only, not acted on: T's page lists the number and a same-option number (not its predecessor/successor) both undated, and no page dates either (the 1119g G05 pattern)
